title: Welcome!
paragraphs: I am Fan Wang, a statistician and educator based in Toronto. I am a Senior Biostatistician at Tigermed, supporting Vertex Pharmaceuticals with a focus on real-world evidence studies and clinical trials. I also teach and develop courses at the University of Toronto’s Data Sciences Institute.

I received my PhD in Statistical Sciences from the University of Toronto, supervised by Lisa Strug and Lei Sun. Previously, I was a Postdoctoral Research Scientist in Biostatistics at Columbia University, working with Iuliana Ionita-Laza. My research focuses on statistical genetics, quantile regression, high-dimensional inference, and the integration of genomic data.
student_statement: I am passionate about helping students build confidence in statistics, develop their research ideas, and strengthen their data analysis and programming skills.
student_followup: I enjoy making challenging concepts accessible through clear explanations, real data, and hands-on examples. Students are welcome to connect with me about coursework, research, and learning in statistics and data science.
teaching_intro: My teaching combines statistical foundations with practical computing and applications in data science and genomics.
teaching_other: Teaching Assistant, University of Toronto (2016–2019): Statistical Theory (STA255), Methods of Data Analysis I (STA302), Methods of Applied Statistics I (STA2101), Statistical Genetics (STA480), and Methods for Multivariate Data (STA437).
Learning Support, Data Sciences Institute, University of Toronto (2025): linear regression, classification, resampling, sampling, and visualization.
Research mentorship in high-dimensional signal detection, colocalization, and clinical risk prediction.
contact_intro: Please feel free to get in touch. When connecting on WeChat, include your name and course or research interest.
